guidedTourSteps.label: Platform overview
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Open the portal for the first time
guidedTourSteps.outcome: See the operating flow, module scope, capabilities, and phased rollout plan.

guidedTourSteps.label: Secure onboarding
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Create users and send first-login access
guidedTourSteps.outcome: Each employee enters through role-based access, 2FA, and audit-friendly sessions.

guidedTourSteps.label: Project setup
guidedTourSteps.trigger: A new construction job is awarded
guidedTourSteps.outcome: The portal creates one source of truth for BOQ, phases, deadlines, team members, and progress.

guidedTourSteps.label: Daily field capture
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Work is completed on site today
guidedTourSteps.outcome: Supervisor input becomes an engineer-verified official report with photos and attachments.

guidedTourSteps.label: Management approval
guidedTourSteps.trigger: A report, document, material request, or invoice needs sign-off
guidedTourSteps.outcome: Approvals move through the correct chain with comments, reminders, escalation, and audit records.

guidedTourSteps.label: Inventory & Stores
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Materials or tools move between warehouse and project site stores
guidedTourSteps.outcome: Warehouse and site stock, tagged tool locations, supplier context, and governed movement workflows.

guidedTourSteps.label: Mobile execution
guidedTourSteps.trigger: Users work from site on low bandwidth
guidedTourSteps.outcome: A PWA-friendly flow keeps drafts, photos, approvals, and notifications usable on phones.

guidedTourSteps.label: Launch path
guidedTourSteps.outcome: MVP scope, acceptance scenarios, migration inputs, and deployment model are defined.

productTourSteps.title: Start with the daily operating story
productTourSteps.body: The first screen now anchors the prototype around one question: what happened on site today, what needs approval, and what changed in management visibility?
productTourSteps.instruction: Open with the operations pulse, then move through project setup, daily report, approval, and dashboard record.

productTourSteps.title: Project baseline
productTourSteps.body: Each job starts with the project code, BOQ, milestones, assigned members, deadlines, and progress rules.
productTourSteps.instruction: Explain that every later report, approval, document, cost, and photo connects back to this baseline.

productTourSteps.title: Daily field capture
productTourSteps.body: Supervisor updates become engineer-verified daily reports with attendance, work progress, safety notes, WIR status, photos, and attachments.
productTourSteps.instruction: Show how informal site updates become a structured company record.

productTourSteps.title: Approval decision
productTourSteps.body: Reports, material requests, documents, and invoices move through role-based approval with SLA reminders, rejection reasons, and audit history.
productTourSteps.instruction: Focus on who approves, what they see, and what happens when an item is rejected or delayed.

productTourSteps.title: Management dashboard record
productTourSteps.body: Approved activity updates the dashboard so managers can see pending approvals, late reports, low stock, document status, and active project progress.
productTourSteps.instruction: Connect the dashboard back to the daily site workflow instead of presenting it as a separate reporting screen.

productTourSteps.title: Controlled documents and evidence
productTourSteps.body: Documents, revisions, photos, and attachments preserve the official project record after field work is submitted and approved.
productTourSteps.instruction: Use this as the proof layer for daily work, WIRs, MARs, MIRs, delivery notes, and photo evidence.

productTourSteps.title: Phase 2 operational depth
productTourSteps.body: Inventory, stores, tool location, suppliers, accounts, and mobile/offline behavior remain visible without distracting from the MVP story.
productTourSteps.instruction: Position these modules as the next layer after the core field-to-management workflow is understood.

productTourSteps.title: Delivery path
productTourSteps.body: The delivery screen summarizes hosting, environments, deployment, backups, testing, migration, and launch acceptance scenarios.
productTourSteps.instruction: Close by showing how the prototype maps to a build plan and acceptance checklist.

walkthroughSteps.title: Create project baseline
walkthroughSteps.detail: Admin/Operation Manager creates project, BOQ, milestones, members, and deadlines.

walkthroughSteps.title: Supervisor submits field update
walkthroughSteps.detail: Attendance, work location, OT, progress, safety, and five site photos are captured.

walkthroughSteps.title: Engineer verifies and submits report
walkthroughSteps.detail: Engineer validates quality/WIR status, adds work summary, and submits official report.

walkthroughSteps.title: Project Manager approves
walkthroughSteps.detail: PM approves, rejects with comments, or lets the system escalate after SLA breach.

walkthroughSteps.title: System updates records
walkthroughSteps.detail: Dashboard, PDF export, email notification, audit log, documents, and costs update.
